name: GUISARD ~Bokura wa Omoi o Mi ni Matou~
original_name: GUISARD～僕らは想いを身に纏う～
source:
Guisard is a combat subdivision which consists of several young people, which dedicated themselves to daily fight with the demons, which threaten humanity.

[From YaoiOtaku]

◆Story◆

GIZARD” is a group of young masked warriors who put on a mask and threw themselves into days of fierce battles for whom? The fateful showdown is imminent!

The “Ganglion” is a modified human being. The evil hand of the “Ganglion” is latching on to each and every one of the Gaiad members....

The distrust that grows, the cracks in everyday life, and the desire to fill the gaps in each other's hearts...,

It is the same for “Ganglion”...



Who is friend and who is foe, the frustration of having one's beliefs crumble with a sound...

The frustration of this makes the hand that raises the whip exert an unexpected force.

The daily routine of the people who are tired of fighting and drown their minds in game arcades and aquariums.

However, the place where they can truly rest is the coffee shop “Sandal Dash,” where the master watches over them with warm eyes.



A shadow falls upon Gaisard in the midst of a fate from which there is no escape! A mysterious figure is active in the dark!

The warriors set out for battle, feeling torn away from their safe haven.

What awaits them is victory or death! Love is born in battle, and hatred gives birth to warped love...



Now, the curtain rises on a life-giving action drama! The story is a one-part drama series.

The viewpoints of enemies and allies intersect and alternate in a multi-view!

Depending on the outcome of the battle, who will be able to achieve their dreams and who will be able to achieve theirs.

The first “Boys' Love” game! The first hard action romance adventure in the world of boys' love!
